sources.title: Tonga Passport Act, Chapter 10.03 (2020 Revised Edition)
sources.publisher: Attorney General's Office, Kingdom of Tonga
sources.officialityEvidence: The Attorney General's Office publishes the current revised Passport Act and defines the Tongan National Passport separately from protected-person and other travel documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Tongan National Passport means a document issued under Part IV of this Act.

sources.title: Regulation No. 795/2022 on visas — current Annex 9 exemption schedule
sources.officialityEvidence: Iceland's official regulation portal publishes the current visa regulation; Annex 9 directly lists Tonga among nationalities exempt from a visa on arrival in Iceland.

sources.officialityEvidence: The live Department of State notice implements Presidential Proclamation 10998 and was last updated on 2 February 2026.

policies.title: Tongan national passports: Iceland short-stay visa-free access
policies.summary: Iceland's current visa regulation directly lists Tonga in its visa-exempt nationality schedule.
conditions: Applies to a valid regular Tongan National Passport and short visits of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period; paid activity is outside the waiver.
The classification is grounded in Iceland's own current Annex 9 exemption schedule; document validity, purpose, means, security checks and final border admission remain separate entry conditions.
This policy does not classify work, residence, diplomatic, service, special, protected-person, emergency, refugee, stateless, crew or other-document treatment.

conflicts.officialStatus: visitor visa issuance and entry partially suspended with limited exceptions
conflicts.explanation: The current U.S. measure suspends issuance of B-1/B-2 visitor visas and entry for affected Tongan nationals who were outside the United States without a valid visa on the effective date, while preserving existing visas and narrow exceptions. That conditional suspension cannot be faithfully flattened to a normal advance-visa status.
